vectors.scenario: Runtime read-only registry/custody/representation records are wrapped with generation/cursor metadata
capture source class or source ID differs from record schema identity
record digest or capture digest is tampered
capture observedAtUnix differs from record observedAt
generation is non-positive or cursor invalid
transport is not READ_ONLY or capture claims effects/finality
capture set misses or duplicates registry/custody/representation class
capture set reuses raw-response evidence hash
verified capture set projects into v9/v11 source metadata

required_invariants: source class and source ID are derived from the source record schema
generation is strictly positive and provider cursor is explicit
recordDigest binds the canonical read-only record
captureHash binds record plus source cursor/generation metadata
verified capture-set contains exactly registry, custody and representation
projected source metadata is the same shape consumed by v9 and v11
capture verification does not create execution or promotion authority
